expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Splits a command line into positional tokens and switches. @param CommandLine Text to parse. @param Tokens Positional results. @param Switches Switch results.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Record every out/inout value before and after the call and verify writeback.
inputs: Representative non-empty value, zero/default value, precision or formatting inputs, and invalid text/specifier input where supported.
testScope: void FCommandLine::Parse(const FString& CommandLine, TArray<FString>&out Tokens, TArray<FString>&out Switches);
